The offices on upper floors should have proper headroom and circulation. The restaurant on the top needs a separate area, maybe with a view.

Circulation strategy includes a central atrium and elevators. Entrance should be at the main lobby on the first floor. Headroom needs to be at least 3 for offices and 2 for the restaurant. Protected voids could be the atrium. Destinations include the lobby, offices, and restaurant. Functional zones are the open spaces, offices, and restaurant.

Now, translating this into B143 elements. The base structure would be a large box for the building. Then, cut out the atrium as a void. Add the central core with stairs and elevators. For the open floors, maybe use cut elements to create the big spaces. Offices can be boxes with concrete walls. The restaurant on the top could be a separate area with glass for views. Use repeat for columns and beams to save on elements. Make sure all elements are within the bounds and materials are correct. Check that the staircase connects the floors properly and the headroom is maintained. Also, ensure that entrances have cut openings.
